rule: Syllabus determines scope; settled economic definitions govern learner wording. These clarifications do not add independent advanced units.

rulings.ruling: Include willingness AND ability to buy, a price range, period and other things equal; the syllabus shorthand omits conditions.
Use rising LONG-RUN average cost as scale rises; distinguish it from diminishing returns with a fixed input.
Explain an increasing sacrifice along a bowed-out PPF with fixed resources and technology. A straight-line schedule has constant opportunity cost and is not evidence of increasing opportunity cost.
Teach only the meanings necessary for the specified market structures; no extra welfare or oligopoly unit.
